## Definition of done (docs/production/definition-of-done.md)
- [ ] Reviewed by someone other than the author
- [ ] Tests or golden replay added/updated; `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` pass
- [ ] Player-facing strings are in `src/i18n/strings/en.json` (+ `en.meta.json`); `npm run i18n:check` passes
- [ ] No new lint errors
- [ ] Changelog line added (player-visible changes)
- [ ] Verified in a build by someone other than the author (captures attached for visual changes)
- [ ] Acceptance criterion met and the roadmap line marked `[x]`
